name: Error-count dink game
summary: Live cross-court dink game to 11 where speed-ups are allowed on high balls; each player counts the rallies they lose with their own unforced errors.
setup: Both players at the non-volley-zone line, cross-court, playing into one half of the court
Live dink rally; a speed-up is allowed only on a ball above net height
Game to 11 rallies; each player tallies rallies lost to their own unforced errors
success_criterion: In a game to 11, lose at most 2 rallies to your own unforced errors
safety_notes: Speed-ups at close range: wear eye protection and aim speed-ups low, never at the face. Stop if in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) Live dinking with a speed-up threat is where patient players lose fewest rallies to their own mistakes; scoring only own unforced errors trains exactly what AN-04 counts. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
